notes.title: V 1.1.0.12 Patch Changlist
notes.content:
1.Fixed several text errors.
2.If auto-save is disabled, the game will not save when sleeping either.
3.Fixed the bug where NPCs in the Joaquin Ranch couldn't be tracked.
4.Fixed the bug with game time counting.
5.Fixed the tracking bug with Dolores.
6.Increased the drop rate of Trophy Equipment slightly in the highest difficulty mode.
7.Added a confirmation window when removing all items from a chest.
8."Catastrophe from Omen": the interval for switching to Hicks increased from 3 to 5.
9.Added a "convert 100 times" option to the Energy Converter and included gems from the Mystical gems series, Intense High-explosive Bomb, Meteor Crystals, and Obsidian Stone as rewards.
10.When NPCs are in investigation mode, Intimacy will no longer be displayed.
11.It is no longer possible to fast travel to the Starfall Pit.
12.Fixed the bug where players could not re-enter the Starfall Pit after escaping.
13.Accessories adjustments: 
(1) After completing the main story, players can exchange missed accessories from skipped side missions at Eudora's shop. 
(2) Accessories now has two levels per quality, with increased level caps. 
(3) Balanced the attributes and material requirements for accessories upgrades. The final level will give more attributes but consume more gold and Veteran Falconeye Medalion.
14.To prevent mistakes, the hammer can no longer be used to clear soil.
15.Added new refining recipes for the Purification Recycler: 
(1) Stone * 5 = Soft Soil * 1 
(2) Limestone * 5 = Soft Soil * 2 
(3) Slate * 5 = Soft Soil * 3
16.Exhibition attribute for the Legendary Citron has been changed from Pyro DMG Boost → Water DMG Boost.
17.Fixed the bug where Ervine's and Miriam's paths could overlap.
18.Reduced the material requirements for building the Doe (N) Defense Line and the Garrison Outposts.
19.In "The Final Battle" VANTOMS will no longer reset cleared areas, and defeating VANTOMS clones will reward multiple Energy Cores.
20.Reduced the start-up delay of all Vambrace-type weapons and increased their energy limits.
21.Increased the damage multiplier of all crossbow-type weapons.
22.The Harbor Caravan will no longer sell duplicate recipes, and the chance of obtaining recipes has been increased.
23.Fixed the bug where HP would not update instantly when Crystallization/uncrystallizing.
24.Hovering over an unlocked entry in the Collection will now display the item's name.
25.Adjusted the calculation for "Armor Penetration," making the stat more effective.
26.Improved the "Fertilizer Transformation" skill, with additional organic material output increased from 3 to 5.
27.Added a quick equipment switch function, allowing a total of three preset gear slots.
28.New Ancient Technology: "Ultra Efficient Picking," greatly increasing the pickup range.
29.New Ancient Technology: "Ultra Efficient Storage," allowing players to store identical items in the High-tech Collection Box of the current scene from the bag (not yet available for controllers).
30.Dolores will now visit Garlant on her birthday.
31.The damage cap has been increased to 99,999,999.
32.Reduced the number of rooms in "Ultimate Ending" and Hicks' storyline battle stages.
33.Adjusted Hicks' attributes when in Terraverm form: each Nirvana reduces max HP and Extra DMG IMM but greatly increases Extra DMG.
34.Added a golden effect to crops and fish that have been collected in the Collection Handbook.
35.High-tech Collection Box functionality improvements: 
(1) The High-tech Collection Box now has the features of the Material Box and Fridge and is no longer restricted by placement locations. 
(2) While crafting at workbench/Kitchen, materials stored in any High-tech Collection Box can now be globally accessed.
36.Ancient-tech Soil will no longer cause crops to mutate.
37.The number of Crystal Energy pickups from the world map has been increased, with additional gains ranging from 0.25% to 0.5% of the current storage limit.
38.Processing machine fixes: 
(1) Fixed bug with dismantling the processing machine/Metero Crystal Smelter. 
(2) The processing machine/Premium Composter/Metero Crystal Smelter/Corrosion Cultivation Medium can now automatically restock items from the Material Box (current scene) or the High-tech Collection Box (not yet available for controllers).
39.Boris' Store will now sell Hardwood/Ebony/Resin/Premium Resin.
40.Players can now select the "Auto Disassemble Non Trophy Equipment" option in the settings.
41.Added a large number of Black Soil respawns in the Sunset Slope Caves.
42.Increased the refresh rate of Brilliant Orichalcum/Brilliant Diamond blueprints in the Harbor Caravan.
43.Fixed the bug where Blessings: Time and Timekeeper Set wouldn't affect the time consumed at Resource Collection Sites/Treasure Spot/Roadblock/Veteran Falconeye Bounty/Terraverm Supply Station.
44.Bombs can now destroy soil mounds, sludge, and black soil.
45.Equipment above the player's level will no longer drop.

notes.title: V1.1.0.11 Patch Changelist
notes.content:
1. Optimised many controller operations and logics.
2. Eating the food you cooked gives you more buffs and the cost of time also decreased.
3. Increased the status of all Special Op Teams in "The Final Battle" mission. All characters' MOV +3.
4. Fixed the bug that the attribute conversion of a set does not calculate the attribute bonus after conversion.
5. Enhanced the ATK/MOV speed/ATK speed of all guard skills and reduced their CD.
6. Fixed a bug that wrong display sometimes happened when trading in the Silver Palace.
7. Time limits of caravan's commisions: 10 days → 15 days.
8. There is a hint now after you accepted a Guild Commision.
9. Foggy Boots' effect: Weak Immunity → Bleed Immunity.
10. Maaya Ripper set now could attack attackable objects and mines on the map.
11. Adjust statues of several sets.
12. Changed some content of Len's reply.
13. Fish and Trophy Equipment obtained in Fish Basket/Reward/Guild Equipment Supply are now credited to the collection book.
14. Fixed a bug that floor could be placed on the water.
15. Now the Tier numbers of Off-sea Cave is visible.
16. The Intimacy with clients show in the Commisions screen now.
17. Fixed some bugs of interact and display in Hicks mode.
18. In the side quest Catastrophe from Omen: From the fourth time of the Eliminate, every third time it switches to the Hicks Purge level. 
19. Refresh time of Mysterious Merchant in exploration: 1 week → 1 day.
20. Rejuvenation became to high yielding vessels. Flowers and mushrooms gained at harvest +50%.
21. Removed Gems will be returned.
22. Improve the effect of poisonous fog, it will start to manifest from a duration of <75% of the time.
23. New Research: Fridge+: capacity: 36 → 56
24. New Research: Material Box+: capacity: 36 → 56
25. Limits of Multiple Convert of Energy Converter: 8 → 10
26. Fixed some text problems.
27. Fixed the bug that you may could not make any progress if defeat the Melvara too quick in the main quest "Blue figure".
28. Fix the bug that Hunter Dual Blade: Fusion & Standard Crossbow: Diablo Game could not be dropped after defeat Alanda & Nadia.
29. New Ancient Technology: Extra efficient fishing. SP consumption about fishing halved. While using Silver fishing rod, you could get Lv.1 fish. While using Gold fishing rod, you could get Lv.2 fish or below, etc.
30. Enhance the chances of good results and rewards for most exploration events.
31. Enhance the effect of "Lucky Guy". Luck +1 for every 10 Gathering Collections.

notes.title: v1.1.0.10 Patch Changelist
notes.content:
1. Fixed the bug that NPC may have a softlock in defense of Doe.
2. Fixed the bug that the main quest ""Beyond the Mist"" may not progress due to Greg.
3. Fixed the bug that some NPCs may still send a gift to you after they disappeared.
4. Fixed the bug that SU LIN's position was incorrectly determined in the very beginning phase.
5. The Intimacy with clients show in the Commisions screen now.
6. The Intimacy will be displayed when you talking with NPCs.
7. The effect cooldown of set Catastrophe: 3s → 2s.
8. New Living Skill: Agriculture Mastery. Learning this skill allows you to view the growth rate of your crops and the number of days remaining to maturity.
9. Enhanced the MOV speed indoor.
10. Fixed the bug that attributes are not updated instantly when replacing accessory equipment.
11. Reduce the time cost of Artificial Seed: 10 mins → 2 mins; Premium Trellis & Cultivation Medium: 20 mins → 10mins.
12. Some NPCs will not be displayed any more in the social information after finishing the main quest ""Beyond the Mist"" & ""Ultimate Ending"".
13. New Ancient Technology: “Extra efficient craft”. All crafting time cost will decrease to 1 min after learning this skill.
14. New Ancient Technology: “Talent Change Potion”. You could craft Talent Change Potion in the Advanced Workbench Blueprint.
15. Speeds up the read speed of Enhancement and Power-surge Level Enhancement. 
16. Standardise all collection read speeds to 1 second.
17. The number of seeds sold in the shop per day has been increased to unlimited
18. Enhance the factor by which unattributed damage is based on level enhancement.
19. It is now possible to drag out the range of buttons before the mouse button is lifted to cancel some incorrect operations.
20. Fixed the bug that floors and carpets can be placed outside the map.
21. Improve the description of ""Luck"" and ""extra DMG IMM""; Add description to ""Lucky Guy"" & ""Business Talent"".
22. It is now possible to quickly cancel the holding status of props with the right mouse button.
23. Planters placed indoors are not affected by the Seasons.
24. NPCs' names are added in the mini map.
25. The number of times of the ‘Blessing’ will not be counted now when entering Treasure Rooms and Gathering Rooms.
26. In the mission ""Eternal Lost"", Boss's CG will not be displayed anymore.
27. I'm Exhausted, Really: Reach Nirvana of Hicks 20 times in total → Reach Nirvana of Hicks 10 times in total"

notes.title: V 1.1.0.9 Patch Changelist
notes.content:
1.Fixed the interaction bug with building the Doe (N) Defense Line
2.Fixed the bug with abnormal Mission Tracking when there is no Main Story.
3.It is now possible to view item descriptions by hovering the mouse over construction materials and Equipment Upgrade Screen.
4.Adjusted Timekeeper Set: Doubles the time consumed in exploration → Halve the time consumed in exploration.
5.Added more detailed descriptions for all crops that can mutated.
6.Speeds up the display speed of all dialogues.
7.Fixed the bug where Greigg's special attack could cause errors.
8.Adjusted the reward mechanism for "Eternal Lost." The number of Energy Core dropped now increases based on the number of rooms cleared: +1 Energy Core for every 10 rooms cleared.
9.The stacking limit for all items (excluding equipment and Weapons) has been adjusted to 999.
10.Adjusted the commission order refresh system, increasing the probability of simpler commission appearing in the early.
11.Added planting season tips for all crops.
12.Crop Collection now includes information on growth cycles, planting season, and crop prices.
13.Increased all the attribute bonuses gained with each character level-up.   
14.Added specific numerical bonus to the talents: "Academic" and "Sports Enthusiast."
15.Improve the description for Trophy Equipment Sets.
16.Energy Refinery Device build material modification: Iron Bramble → Artichoke .
17.Improve the Artificial Seed: It is now impossible to produce out-of-season crops.

notes.title: v 1.1.0.8 Patch Changelist
notes.content:
1.Added the display of chest names and colors in the screen, and the chest name color will now synchronize with the chest color.
2.The stacking limit for all crops, seeds, and collections items has been adjusted to 999.
3.Improved the quality and quantity of drops in forest chests.
4.Improved the display of trellis inside crop cultivation room.
5.Fixed the bug where the special effect display of the Cursed Set persisted after exiting exploration.
6.Enhanced the effect of the Cursed Set: it now has a larger range, faster rotation speed, and shorter attack intervals.
7.Crops harvested using the agricultural automation device can now trigger the“Crystal Touch” effect.
8.Storage size increased from 3 pages to 5 pages, with 2 additional pages added per upgrade.
9.Added a hint to the Mushroom Spore description as to whether it can mutated or not.
10.The production speed of the Seed Recycler has been doubled.
11.Fixed the bug where Andrew could disappear during the main story“Dream and Ambition.”
12.Agricultural automation devices can now be set to automatically plant harvested seeds.
13.Added guidance on how to deal with the deserted soil within the manor.
14.The assistant guide for commissions will no longer point to NPCs with incomplete commissions.
15.Fixed the bug where the Energy Converter could not obtain Infinity Crystal.
16.NPCs with a relationship status of "Friend" or higher can now have their commissions or orders submitted directly through the menu, though this will not increase Intimacy.
17.Fixed display bug in Mission Tracking.
18.Fixed several English localization issues.

notes.title: V 1.1.0.7 Patch Changelist
notes.content:
1.Added the display of the current NPC’s relationship status and Intimacy level during daily conversations.
2.Improved task prompts for the side mission“Riverside Corridors” and “Forbidden Eternity.”
3.Improved the categorization of material-type items.
4.Added a naming function for chests, material boxes, and Fridge, along with a “Take All” feature.
5.Fixed the bug where Mystical gems would disappear when split.
6.Fixed incorrect styles for the Assault Guardian and Hellfire Guardian.
7.Fixed the bug where only one item was received when obtaining multiple identical collections.
8.Increased the output quantity of Fish Baskets, boosted the Tech Development Platform's bonus to Fish Basket output, and Fish Baskets can now accumulate harvests.
9.Chicken Coop, Cowshed, and Sheepfold now provide 5 days of effect per feeding, and the material requirements for Fodder have been increased.
10.Reduced the requirements for obtaining tool upgrade script. Cobalt Blueprint tool scripts can now be purchased after a single upgrade of the Intimacy of corresponding store owner.
11.Fixed the bug where the tracker could point to non-existent Mission.
12.Wildflowers and wild vegetables are now affected by the skill "Collect Enhance."
13.Added an additional description to the “Black Soil” item.
14.Fixed several map display issues.

notes.title: V 1.1.0.6 Patch Changelist
notes.content:
1.The side mission "Mattie's Trouble" has been upgraded to a main story, and the mission guide flow and prompts have been adjusted to optimize the unclear acquisition method of tools early in the game.
2.Fixed the bug where obtained items were not displayed when skipping the story.
3.Added hover tooltips in the falconeye skill menu, guiding where to learn other skill and machine scripts.
4.Increased the maximum UI scaling ratio. Please adjust according to your needs.
5.Fixed the bug where Terraverms could dash out of the map.
6.Enhanced the talents: Academic and Sports Enthusiast.
7.Improved the character's movement speed indoors.
8.Added crafting hints for some processed products, such as Molding Powder and Gunpowder.
9.Fixed the bug where characters could get stuck after digging up chests at treasure spot.
10.Improved Leland's fishing tutorial, with clearer instructions on how to use bait.
11.Optimized the Notice Board display, where now you can check the quantity of required items in your bag through the description of items needed for commissions and orders.
12.Fixed several English localization issues.

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
notes.content:
Hello Falconeyes,

We are very excited to bring you this big news about the game!

-Basic Game Information:

Release Date: September 5th
Platforms: Steam, Nintendo Switch (Japan, Europe, North America)
Pricing:
Steam: The final price is ¥37.8, original price ¥42, with a 10% launch discount for the first two weeks.
Nintendo Switch: Priced at $15.99 in the US, ¥2,000 in Japan, and €15.79 in Europe, with a 10% discount for the first two weeks.

-Is there cloud save support?
Yes, the game supports cloud saving.

-Is online multiplayer available?
The game currently only supports single-player gameplay.

-Can the UI size be adjusted?
Yes, you can adjust the UI size in the settings under "Interface Scaling."

-Is Steam Workshop supported?
Currently, Steam Workshop is not supported. During development, features such as character customization and outfit changes were considered, but due to practical limitations, they were not implemented. If possible in the future, we may explore other ways to implement these features.

notes.title: Garlant: My Story launches September 5, 2024!
notes.content:
Hello Falconeyes,

We are very excited to bring you this big news about the game!

Galant: My Story will launch simultaneously on Steam and Nintendo Switch on September 5th, and the game will support three languages: Chinese, English, and Japanese.

See you in Garlant on September 5th!

notes.title: Recruitment for player beta testing
notes.content:
If you are a hardcore management (farming) gamer or RPG player, we sincerely invite you to participate in the internal test of "Garlan: My Story." With over 60 hours of solid content, it promises an enjoyable experience!

Details of the test recruitment are as follows:
1.This test is completely free of charge. Please do not trust any so-called "staff" who ask you for payment.
2.Registration for this test will be conducted via email. The only official registration email is: support@gameragame.com.
3.To facilitate our selection of testers, please ensure the subject line of the registration email is: "Garlan: My Story Test Recruitment," and introduce your past gaming experience and playtime in the email.
4.The game test period will last until the end of July. The minimum requirement for the test is to play for around 10-15 hours. Please evaluate your available time in advance.
5.Please ensure in advance that you can actively cooperate and fill out the feedback questionnaire during the test. All tester IDs will appear in the game's credits, and you will receive a Steam gift card as a thank you.
6.Please keep the game content confidential during the test period.

notes.title: v0.2.2.21 Patch Out Now
notes.content:
The v0.2.2.21 patch is now available. 
1.Addressed several issues that could potentially prevent the game from running smoothly.
2.Added support for 4K screens.
3.Implemented a new option in the game that allows users to toggle vertical sync. If you encounter screen flickering or visual glitches, you can try resolving them by disabling vertical sync.

notes.title: Join our closed beta-test!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's a pleasure to bring you some news about Garlant: My Story.

After a long time of development, the game is finally going to make its debut!

We are currently planning a closed beta-test. You could send a sign-up email to lucong@gameragame.com if you are interested, we will reply as soon as possible.
